腰椎中段水平的下背部横断面：胸腰筋膜与肌肉分隔

text.aria-label: Seen from above (anterior up); the person's right side is on the right — 上面观（前方在上）；身体右侧在图右侧
text.tspan: Seen from above (anterior up); the person's right side is on the right
上面观（前方在上）；身体右侧在图右侧

text.aria-label: Abdominal wall muscles (cut) — 腹壁肌（切断）
Posterior layer: spinous processes to the lateral raphe, over the erector spinae and multifidus. Middle layer: transverse process tips to the lateral raphe. — 后层：从棘突越过竖脊肌和多裂肌到外侧缝。中层：从横突尖到外侧缝。
text.tspan: Posterior layer: spinous processes to the lateral raphe, over the erector spinae and multifidus. Middle layer: transverse process tips to the lateral raphe.
后层：从棘突越过竖脊肌和多裂肌到外侧缝。中层：从横突尖到外侧缝。

text.aria-label: Anterior layer: over the front of quadratus lumborum. Transversus abdominis and internal oblique attach at the lateral raphe. — 前层：覆盖腰方肌前面。腹横肌和腹内斜肌附着在外侧缝。
text.tspan: Anterior layer: over the front of quadratus lumborum. Transversus abdominis and internal oblique attach at the lateral raphe.
前层：覆盖腰方肌前面。腹横肌和腹内斜肌附着在外侧缝。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
